chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him)
In it, he warns against following desires and prolonging hope in the world

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: The worldly life, the temporal realm
key_terms.الْأَمَلُ: Hope or expectation, specifically here referring to prolonged expectation of life in the world
key_terms.الْهَوَى: Base desires or whims that lead one away from reason and divine guidance

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali warn against regarding desires and worldly hope?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) identifies *al-hawa* (base desire) and *tawallud al-amal* (prolonged hope in the world) as the twin engines of spiritual negligence, a concept deeply rooted in Shia ethical theology where the self must be disciplined to achieve proximity to God. This warning echoes the Quranic narrative of those who take their desires as their god, urging believers to prioritize the eternal hereafter over the deceptive allure of temporal existence.
